title: Safe Online Bid Optimization with Return on Investment and Budget Constraints

problem.claim: Online bid optimization must balance high volume and profitability while satisfying ROI and budget constraints under uncertainty.

gap.claim: Constraint violations during exploration obstruct the adoption of online learning, creating a need for algorithms that control violations while managing regret.

contributions.claim: The learning problem is inapproximable within any factor unless P = NP.
The paper provides a pseudo-polynomial-time algorithm for the discretized learning problem and introduces GCB, GCBsafe, and GCBsafe(ψ, φ) with different regret and constraint-violation guarantees.
No online learning algorithm can achieve both sublinear regret and a sublinear number of ROI or budget constraint violations during learning.

author_reported_evidence.claim: GCB guarantees sublinear regret at the cost of a linear number of constraint violations.
GCBsafe guarantees, with high probability, a constant upper bound on constraint violations at the cost of linear regret.
Experiments compare the regret and constraint violations of GCB, GCBsafe, and GCBsafe(ψ, φ).

narrative_sequence.summary: Online marketing seeks to balance volume and profitability through ROI and budget-constrained optimization.
Uncertainty about constraint parameters makes exploration potentially violate constraints, hindering adoption and trust.
The paper characterizes the optimization and learning problems through inapproximability, discretization, and an impossibility result for jointly sublinear regret and violations.
The paper presents GCB, GCBsafe, and GCBsafe(ψ, φ), offering different tradeoffs among regret, safety, and constraint tolerances.
Experiments compare regret and constraint violations across the proposed algorithms.

source_observation.claim: The abstract reports an incompatibility between sublinear regret and a sublinear number of constraint violations under exact ROI and budget constraints.

interpretation.claim: Safety requirements can impose a fundamental performance cost in online learning.

application.claim: When deploying online optimization with hard constraints, explicitly choose and communicate a tradeoff among regret, violation frequency, and constraint tolerances.

exception.claim: The tradeoff may change when tolerances in ROI and budget satisfaction are accepted.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the formal model, assumptions, parameter ranges, or discretization details.
The abstract does not provide experimental datasets, baselines, metrics, numerical results, or statistical procedures.
The abstract does not establish practical deployment performance or independent verification.
